source_refs.note: 2- Cloning of Recombinant Vector: a main subheading of 20.2.2 Steps of Recombinant DNA Technology, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 158-159.

blocks.text: The recombinant DNA (vector) and the expression system (usually bacteria) are incubated in the same medium. The bacterial cells take up recombinant DNA. All the incubated bacteria make bacterial clones which also contain the identical copies i.e., clones of the gene of interest.
